name: html-ppt-studio
description: Turns raw material into a reviewed outline, a page-by-page slide spec, and a runnable HTML presentation — four gated steps with a stored judgment library and a switchable style library.

displayDescription.en: Turns your material into an outline, a page-by-page slide spec, and a runnable HTML deck. Four gated reviews, recorded judgments, switchable styles.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的资料拆成大纲、逐页分镜与可放映的 HTML 演示页，四步审核、判断有据、风格可换。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一份资料，想做成一份 HTML 汇报 PPT
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have material and want it turned into an HTML presentation

quickPrompts.zh: 先按判断库出大纲，我审完再动逐页内容
quickPrompts.en: Draft the outline using my judgment library, and wait for my review
